feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
entry.summary: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

entry.title: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
entry.summary: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

entry.title: The Emmys are Monday night. Here's how to watch
entry.summary: Noah Kahan will perform "Bridge Over Troubled Water" as part of the In Memoriam segment.

entry.title: New Carlo Rovelli book challenges science's understanding of reality and the universe
entry.summary: In his latest book, the world-renowned physicist draws on science and philosophy to explore the notion that the university and reality are fully knowable.

entry.title: NPR looked for ChatGPT's new crisis feature. It's hard to find
entry.summary: Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.

entry.title: Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea
entry.summary: Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.

entry.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
entry.summary: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

entry.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier whose plane careened off Miami runway
entry.summary: Amazon said it's decided to pause operations with 21 Air as the investigation into the crash continues. North Carolina-based 21 had flown packages for Amazon since 2024.

entry.title: Trump downplays calls for AI slowdown
entry.summary: President Trump said the dire warnings about AI were exaggerated and that "negative forces" are making claims about things that won't happen. This comes after leaders in the industry called for putting the brakes on AI development.

entry.title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
entry.summary: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.
